about: LemurSaucePacket progression proposal (not applied). kind: craft = making it (CRAFT; machine: true = Create-style machine), wear = Project MMO WEAR (relics: RELIC_WEAR), hold = WEAPON (+WEAR penalty), use = USE/TOOL, place = PLACE on the block, chop = CHOP (BREAK on logs), brew = BREW ingredient. impact: 1-5.

proposals.why: A vault block holds 20 stacks and vaults join into one big inventory (up to 3x3 across): far past a chest. The shipping containers of Create Deco and the item silo of Create Connected are the same storage from their own recipes, so they share this gate.
Same storage as the item vault from its own recipe (iron sheet and barrel): it would skip the vault gate otherwise.
Create Deco makes these from a barrel, dye and an iron sheet, no vault needed, so they would skip the vault gate.
Moves items between many inventories with no belts: the core of brass-age automation. Between the crossbow (20) and the mechanical crafter (30).
A call-anywhere lift for players. Travel sits on Agility (elytra 30, train stations 35).

proposals.what: Stock tickers, redstone requesters and factory gauges
proposals.why: Create 6's stock keeping: order anything in a vault network from one counter and let gauges keep production topped up. The pack's answer to AE2, so it comes after the enchanting table (40). Packagers, frogports and postboxes stay open.
Mirrors every block you place across up to three planes. Made only by mechanical crafters, so the gate is on using it (a Project MMO USE rule, like the Builder's Wand).

Greatly increases reach for whatever is in the main hand, swords included: a PvP edge. Made only by mechanical crafters, so it is a held-item rule (Project MMO WEAR with Weakness, as swords have). Attack 40 matches the Brass Duelist set.
A carried store that also hands tools to players nearby: an early convenience, gated like the shield (15).

proposals.what: Capacitors (and so electric motors, tesla coils and accumulators)
proposals.why: Electricity is a second power network: electric motors turn stored power back into rotation anywhere and tesla coils charge gear and shock mobs. Motors and coils come only from mechanical crafters, so the crafting-table capacitor every one of them needs carries the gate, the way the gear sets' hand-made parts do. After the mechanical crafter (30), with the steam engine (Smithing 35).
Hurts anything that walks through it: base defence on a PvP server with no land claims.
Automated disenchanting into liquid experience, the fuel for blaze enchanters, printers and new Hearts.
Absorbs experience from orbs and from players standing near it (on contraptions too): an XP bank and the end of an XP farm.

An anvil with no repair cost that also applies and strips enchanting templates; fed Cake o' Enchanting it super-enchants, merging conflicting enchantments and passing the vanilla caps. Past the printer (50). The pack's super_enchanting data map should hold the level caps; check it does here too.

proposals.what: Ore vein finders and the vein atlas
proposals.why: Prospecting for infinite veins. Drilling them already waits for Mining 50 (the drill head), so scouting comes a little earlier.
Automates the cutting board (slicing, butchery, bark) for Create kitchens: the next Cooking machine after the encased fan (20).
Waters and fertilises an area so crops grow faster: the next Farming machine after the harvester and plough (15).
A tunnel-boring head that cuts a wide face as it turns: the step past the drill (Mining 15). Like every machine it still only breaks up to Hardness II.

A cannon on an airship. The handheld potato cannon needs Ranged 20; this one is mechanical-crafted, so the gate is on placing it (a Project MMO PLACE rule). The rest of Aeronautics stays open, as decided in 1.13.0.
A press in the backpack with no rotation. The owner asked for this mod by name, so confirm before gating it.
A mixer in the backpack with no rotation or basin. The owner asked for this mod by name, so confirm before gating it.
The backpack ladder (leather stays free): each tier adds rows and upgrade slots.
Backpack ladder, Andesite age.
Backpack ladder, Brass age (brass casings in the recipe).
Backpack ladder: with the ender chest (50).
Backpack ladder: a netherite upgrade at the smithing table, after netherite gear (50).
The first upgrades: small conveniences.

proposals.what: Crafting upgrade and the starter stack upgrade
proposals.why: A crafting grid on your back (its results still obey the making gates) and the first stack bonus.
Empty into or fill from any container with a sneak-click, and keep a hotbar stack topped up.

proposals.what: Void, tool swapper, tank and stack tier 1 upgrades
proposals.why: Mid-tier conveniences: delete junk, pick the right tool by itself, carry fluids, 2x stacks.

proposals.what: Magnet, compacting and advanced pickup/filter upgrades
proposals.why: Pulls in drops from a distance and packs ores and crops into blocks as you go: big quality-of-life, Brass age.

proposals.what: Advanced restock, deposit, refill, void and tool swapper upgrades, and stack tier 2
proposals.why: The advanced versions add filters and remote picking; stack tier 2 (4x, the pack's cap) already needs brass casings.

proposals.what: Advanced magnet and advanced compacting upgrades
proposals.why: Wider pull with filters, and 3x3 compacting: the strongest everyday upgrades.
A stonecutter on your back for builders.
A furnace on your back, with iron (15).
A blast furnace and an anvil on your back; the anvil block itself is Smithing 20.
Smelts what you pick up with no menu at all. Note: with a pickup upgrade it can turn raw ores into free ingots past the Hardness use-gate (see the skips list).
The faster ore version of auto-smelting.
A smithing table on your back, for netherite upgrades in the field (netherite gear is Smithing 50). Check its result slot obeys the smithing gate.
A smoker on your back.
Eats for you from the backpack.
Cooks what you pick up; eats by your own rules.
Drinks potions and effect foods for you, the moment they help: strong in PvP.
Alchemy with effect filters: with the stronger (glowstone) potions at Brewing 60.
Links storages into one shared group, ender-chest style: with the ender chest (50).
Your own fast-travel point. They come only from mechanical crafters (and found ones are taken home), so the gate is on placing one; the city's global waystone stays usable for everyone.
Every sharestone of a colour links for everyone: a public network.
Send-only stones (nothing can warp to them): cheaper and weaker than a waystone.
Paired teleport pads.
A reusable teleport to any waystone you have found, from anywhere: the strongest travel item.
One-use teleports, made at a crafting table.
A one-use teleport to any waystone you have found.
The costliest scroll (an ender eye in the recipe).
Bounces you on landing and launches a crouch-jump.
Stores a tamed mount and calls it back anywhere.
Walks on liquids and carries fluids like a bucket.
Builds up speed while you run.
Glides and keeps momentum (the Aeronaut set synergy, whose set needs Agility 40).
Blink-teleports you forward on use: a PvP chase and escape tool.
Rewinds you along your recent path: an escape button (and the Prospector set synergy).
Attacks sometimes miss you, it leaves decoys, and you can walk on air.
Kills drop meatballs.
Shares relic experience between your relics.
Piglins leave you alone and barter more generously.
Stores part of the damage you take and throws it back.
A timed parry that blocks a hit outright.
More max health and regeneration in water or rain, plus a shock.
Spend a third of your health to heal twice that back.
Every so often it cancels a killing blow and makes you immortal for a few seconds: a free death save on a lifesteal server.
Your pets hit harder, and it adds charm slots. (Strength unlocks nothing yet.)

proposals.what: Ring of the Seven Deadly Sins
proposals.why: Big damage modifiers (height, wrath, envy) plus luck (the Brass Duelist synergy).
Moon-phase damage and attack speed, invisibility in the dark, falling stars.
Walk through leaves, heal among them, and cheat death with nearby foliage: a forester's relic.
Silver is iron-plus (bonus against undead) and only comes from ice dragon dens: one step past iron (15).

proposals.what: Silver sword and axe (to hit with)
proposals.why: Weapon tier between iron (15) and diamond (30), as vanilla tiers do (Project MMO WEAPON).
Tool tier like the vanilla ones (Project MMO TOOL).
Tool tier like the vanilla ones.
Tool tier like the vanilla ones.
Armour tier between iron (15) and diamond (30).

proposals.what: Copper sword and axe (to hit with)
proposals.why: Stone-tier weapons: the stone tier is 5.
Stone-tier tools.
Stone-tier tools.
Stone-tier tools.
Between leather and chainmail, like Create's copper diving gear (Defence 5).
Dragon bones and wither bones: past diamond, before netherite-plus.

proposals.what: Dragonbone sword and axe (to hit with)
proposals.why: Between netherite (50) and the elemental swords (60).
Past netherite (50).
Past netherite (50).
Past netherite (50).
A bow of dragon bone: past the trident (40).

proposals.what: Flamed, iced and lightning dragonbone swords
proposals.why: A dragonbone sword soaked in dragon blood: burns, freezes or shocks on hit.
Elemental damage on top of dragonbone.
The best gear in the pack, from ingots forged in a dragon's breath. Ingots stay free (the rule for ingots); making the gear is master smithing, past the mace (70).

proposals.what: Dragonsteel swords and axes (to hit with)
proposals.why: Stronger than netherite (50) and the Stormcaller's Sabre (50): only armour is quest-gated today, so the weapons have no gate at all.
The fastest picks in the pack.
The fastest axes in the pack.
The best hoes in the pack.
Wearing it already needs Dragon Slayer I; making it from scales becomes a Crafting feat, with the end crystal (60). (Optional, not proposed: a Defence 60 wear level on top of the quest gate.)
The forge that turns iron into dragonsteel with a dragon's breath. It runs with no player (dragonsteel is an ingot), so the gate is on building it, as with Create's machines.

proposals.what: Dragon eggs (placing one to hatch it)
proposals.why: A dragon is the strongest mount, pet and forge fuel in the pack. Raising one is master husbandry; the egg can still be carried, traded and kept (a Project MMO USE rule on placing it).
Store your dragon and call it to you anywhere.
Carries a tamed dragon as an item.
Points at the nearest dragon: hunting roosts for scales and bones.

proposals.what: Epic dragon seekers (smithing, a nether star)
proposals.why: Longer range seeker.
The best seeker.
Exotic dishes from dragon flesh, past the feasts (50).
The vanilla gold tier (Smithing 10).
The vanilla iron tier (Smithing 15).
The vanilla diamond tier (Crafting 30).
The vanilla netherite tier (Smithing 50).
The stone tier (5).
Knives are fast weapons with Backstabbing: same tiers as swords.

proposals.what: Iron knives and the skillet (to hit with)
proposals.why: Iron-tier weapons.
Diamond-tier weapon.
Netherite-tier weapon.
A drink with minor instant health.
Clears a harmful effect: a cure in a mug.
Farmer's Delight's newest feast, missing from the feasts gate (Cooking 50).
Turns into rich soil, which speeds every crop planted on it.

proposals.what: Totem of Freezing (held or in the charm slot)
proposals.why: Freezes everything near you when you drop below half health (works from the charm slot). Consider the vanilla Totem of Undying at Hitpoints 50 too.

proposals.what: Totem of Illusion (held or in the charm slot)
proposals.why: Turns you invisible and leaves decoys when you drop below half health: an escape.
The Nether citadel boss's helmet: with the loot-only Ember Crown (40).
Longer block reach. With Weakness, Harming and Invisibility (45).
Pushes an enchantment one level past its maximum: the only way past the caps besides the skill. Check it respects the Enchanting caps.
Platinum trims carry effects (agility, endurance, featherweight, insight), so trimming becomes more than cosmetic; trim copying is Smithing 40.
Reveals the creatures around you: scouting.
Tells you which ores are nearby: prospecting. Loot-only, so the gate is on using it.
A heavy illager weapon. (Strength unlocks nothing yet.)
Illager Invasion's potion, brewed from an awkward potion and a goat horn; with Regeneration (40).
A shield with a charge: bash through, explode, and a guaranteed critical after.
A campfire you infuse with a potion so it gives the effect to everyone nearby.
A happy ghast is a flying mount for four, reachable in the Nether before the elytra (Agility 30 to wear); the harness is what lets you ride it.
Many kinds of item in one slot; Vanilla Backport turns their recipe on.
The creaking's eerie forest: with the dark oaks (35) of the CHOP ladder.
Common taiga trees: a first step.
Tropical trees, with jungle trees (15).
Desert and golden-taiga trees.

proposals.what: Cypresses, ashen trees and bioshroom stems
proposals.why: Bayou, burnt-forest and cave trees.
RuneScape's willow is level 30.
With dark oak (35), like RuneScape's teak.
Flowering and savanna giants.
RuneScape's maple is level 45.
Rainforest giants, like RuneScape's mahogany (50).
Rare dragon-blood trees and the dark blackwood taiga.
Nether trees past crimson and warped stems (60).
RuneScape's redwood is the top tree (90 there); these giants drop the most logs per tree.

hardness.why: Ice and Fire silver: gold-rare (only in ice dragon dens, its world ore is switched off). Ingots stay free, as with every metal.
Raw redstone from Ore Excavation's redstone veins mills and crushes into redstone (tier II). Machines feeding it stay exempt; a player hand-milling it should not be.
Ice and Fire sapphire is a gem from ice dragon dens, a diamond-tier find (emeralds stay free only because they are money).

Regions Unexplored's cobalt obsidian is tagged #c:obsidians (crying), so tag-based recipes (the wand of symmetry, the backpack void upgrade) take it in place of obsidian, and a diamond pickaxe breaks it with no Hardness.
Raw diamond from Ore Excavation: its vein is removed, but if it ever returns it is a raw diamond. (Raw emerald stays free, like emeralds.)

hardnessOptional.why: Crushing crimsite gives crushed raw iron and asurine crushed raw zinc with no Mining level (they mine like stone). Materials list only: the stones stay breakable and placeable, but a player could no longer hand-feed them to a millstone or crusher. Crushing wheels take items dropped on them, so this only narrows the route; machines are exempt by design.
Crushing ochrum gives crushed raw gold (and electrum nuggets) with no Mining level. Same caveat as above.

skips.route: createaddition:filling/cake: a spout fills a baked cake base with milk
skips.fix: The machine rule covers basins, mechanical crafters and the Crafter, not the spout. Extend it to Create's filling, deploying and sequenced assembly results, or remove the recipe in KubeJS.

skips.route: farmersdelight:integration/create/filling/chocolate_pie: a spout fills a pie crust with chocolate
simulated:sequenced_assembly/engine_assembly lists an iron helmet among its scrap results (a small chance)
skips.fix: Minor (wearing still needs Defence 15); the sequenced-assembly machine rule above would cover it.

skips.route: Create Deco shipping containers (barrel, dye, iron sheet) and Create Connected item silos (iron sheet, barrel) are vaults from their own recipes
skips.fix: Gate them with the vault (included in the proposals).

skips.route: Cobalt obsidian is in #c:obsidians, which the wand of symmetry and the void upgrade accept, and it needs no Hardness to break
skips.fix: Add it to tier III (included in the Hardness additions).

skips.gate: Hardness I and II (iron, zinc, gold)
skips.route: Create's ore stones (and tuff) crush into crushed raw iron, zinc and gold, and nuggets, with no Mining level
skips.fix: A machine route, exempt by design; see the optional Hardness additions if it should narrow.

skips.route: A backpack with a pickup upgrade takes raw ores off the ground without a menu click, and auto-smelting/blasting turns them into ingots (which are free)
skips.fix: Have the use-gate also check backpack pickup (Sophisticated's pickup event) or give the auto-smelting upgrades a filter that refuses gated materials.

skips.route: The imbuing table raises an enchantment past its maximum; the blaze forger combines books with no player at an anvil
skips.fix: Check both against the caps (the anvil and table checks do not run there). Using an over-cap item still needs the level, so this is a making gap, not a use gap.

skips.route: The backpack's smithing and anvil tabs have their own result slots
skips.fix: Test that the smithing-table gate (netherite gear, Smithing 50) and the anvil enchanting caps apply there; the crafting upgrade is known to be covered.

skips.route: Farmer's Delight (cake from milk bottles, pies from slices or crust) and Naturalist (duck-egg cake and pumpkin pie) add crafting-grid recipes for gated vanilla foods
skips.fix: The making gate checks the result, so every crafting-grid recipe for a gated item is already gated.
